title: Hyperref macro profile for the URL-deduplicated N=1,000 source

method.compilation: One direct tagged LuaLaTeX pass using the converged candidate .aux and .toc seeds; no .out seed.
method.instrumentation: Lua os.clock wrappers around each complete hyperref hyperlink and href macro call.

comparison.interpretation: The source reduction cuts measured href calls by 5,884 and their inclusive time by about 62%, while hyperlink calls remain unchanged. The hyperlink interval is inclusive and its 1.901-second increase over the previous single profile is not a matched performance result. Both profiles are diagnostic single passes with seeded auxiliaries.

limits: One instrumented direct pass; the timing is targeting data and not a matched speed comparison.
Each interval encloses the complete hyperref macro and its nested tagpdf work; intervals are inclusive and must not be added as independent costs.
Timer overhead was not calibrated separately.
The direct pass uses converged .aux and .toc seeds and does not measure complete multipass export time.
decision: External URL macro work is lower after deduplication. Internal hyperlink macro work remains around 51 CPU seconds in this tagged pass; investigate this path without removing accessible Link structure.
